headline: High: Perplexity can ingest uploaded documents and browse web content while Pipecat can route text/audio through shared buses and third-party LLM/STT/TTS APIs, creating default-path leakage and cascading-error risks.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Perplexity ingests uploaded PDFs/images and browsing context, so attacker-controlled content can enter its outputs. Pipecat runs on a shared bus and handles text/conversation state, so if it consumes Perplexity output as instructions, prompt injection is plausible. No direct shared channel is documented, so this is inferred from both profiles.
conditions: IF Pipecat consumes Perplexity-generated text as instructions without sanitization
IF Perplexity output is copied into a shared bus or message queue used by Pipecat
mitigations: Add an explicit instruction/content separator in the handoff
Strip markdown/code blocks before passing text onward
Require a human review step for any Perplexity-derived instructions
Disable automatic execution of tool-like text in Pipecat
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to all cross-agent messages

B_data_leakage.rationale: Perplexity handles uploaded documents and browsing context, while Pipecat touches text, conversation state, and can call multiple third-party LLM/STT/TTS APIs. If the pair shares a workspace or bus, sensitive document content can flow from A into B and then out to external providers. The shared workspace is not explicitly documented, so uncertainty is escalated to medium.
conditions: IF uploaded documents or browsing context from Perplexity are forwarded into Pipecat prompts
IF Pipecat is configured with external STT/LLM/TTS providers
mitigations: Keep Perplexity uploads out of Pipecat inputs
Use local-only providers in Pipecat for sensitive sessions
Redact secrets before any cross-agent transfer
Turn off analytics/telemetry for the session
requires-engineering: isolate the agents into separate workspaces

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Perplexity cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, and Pipecat exposes no filesystem write capability in the profile. Their overlap is mainly read/transport and shared conversation state, so direct write-write conflict is not evident. Because Pipecat’s mutable surfaces are underspecified, uncertainty remains but the blast radius appears small.
conditions: IF Pipecat is extended with filesystem or git write tools outside this profile
IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable external resource
mitigations: Avoid giving both agents write access to the same directory
Keep git operations outside the pair
Use read-only mounts for shared inputs
Serialize any shared-resource updates
requires-engineering: add locking around mutable resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity produces search-derived answers and citations, and Pipecat can route text through LLM and speech pipelines. If Pipecat treats Perplexity output as authoritative, errors can cascade into downstream spoken or acted-on responses. Because Pipecat has multiple external API paths and no verification step is documented, the default-path blast radius is broad.
conditions: IF Pipecat forwards Perplexity answers into downstream LLM or TTS steps without verification
IF any downstream consumer acts on the generated text
mitigations: Insert a verification step before downstream use
Require citations or source links for factual claims
Limit Pipecat to read-only presentation of Perplexity output
Log and flag low-confidence answers
requires-engineering: add automated fact-checking before action-taking

E_compliance.rationale: Perplexity is vendor-hosted and touches uploaded documents and browsing context, while Pipecat can send text/audio/video to allowlisted third-party services. If regulated data such as EU PII or sensitive documents enters the pair, residency and retention obligations may diverge across vendors. The profiles do not document matching compliance controls, so the safer choice is medium.
conditions: IF regulated personal data is entered into Perplexity and then forwarded through Pipecat
IF the chosen Pipecat providers have different retention or residency terms
mitigations: Do not route regulated data through the pair
Select providers with documented residency terms
Disable logging where possible
Minimize stored conversation state
requires-engineering: perform a vendor compliance review
